name: Variance Analysis and Explanation
title: Variance Analysis and Explanation
answer: Variance analysis and explanation covers the comparison of planned or forecast figures against actual results, and the work of identifying why differences occurred. In an AI accountant context it includes both financial and operational variances, such as revenue, cost, margin, headcount and inventory movements. The output is not just a number but a plain language account of drivers, timing and one-off events. It sits between forecasting models and management reporting, turning model error into business insight.

crumbs.name: Knowledge Based Professions and their Future

sections.body: Variance analysis and explanation covers the comparison of planned or forecast figures against actual results, and the work of identifying why differences occurred. In an AI accountant context it includes both financial and operational variances, such as revenue, cost, margin, headcount and inventory movements. The output is not just a number but a plain language account of drivers, timing and one-off events. It sits between forecasting models and management reporting, turning model error into business insight.
sections.heading: Scope

sections.body: The work runs on the same data stores that feed planning and actuals: general ledgers, ERP extracts, CRM pipelines and data warehouses. Forecast outputs and actuals are joined in a planning or analytics layer, often with versioned snapshots so that the original plan can be compared against later reforecasts. Compute is usually modest, batch oriented, and scheduled after period close or on a rolling basis. Access controls and row level security matter because variance explanations touch sensitive budget and performance data.
sections.heading: What it runs on

sections.body: Analysts and models first reconcile actuals to the plan at the right level of granularity, then split the total variance into components such as price, volume, mix, timing and exchange rate. Machine learning can help by scoring many candidate drivers against the variance and ranking them by contribution, using techniques like Shapley values or regression decomposition. The explanation step converts those ranked drivers into sentences that a finance reviewer can verify. Human judgment remains central for confirming unusual items, correcting data errors and deciding what is material.
sections.heading: How the work is done

sections.body: Variance explanations carry risk because they can be used to justify bonuses, investment decisions or external reporting, so provenance and auditability are essential. Every figure in an explanation should trace back to a source system, a model version and a sign-off, and any AI generated narrative must be clearly marked as draft until reviewed. Bias can enter through the choice of variance thresholds, the training data for driver scoring, or the language model used to write the explanation. Rights issues include who may see individual performance variances and how long the underlying data is retained.
sections.heading: Rights, risk and provenance

sections.body: The field is moving from static month end commentary to continuous variance monitoring, where unusual movements are flagged as they happen rather than after close. Causal inference methods are being added so that explanations distinguish correlation from genuine drivers, such as a price change versus a competitor action. Generative models are improving at drafting full management commentary, but the likely near term change is tighter integration with planning workflows, so that a variance explanation can trigger a reforecast or a corrective action in the same system.
